Domestic South Korea hair care market. Forecast USD 2.4bn by 2034. Other aggregators cluster at USD 1.30-1.31bn 2024 (EMR/Research and Markets, not independently fetched) — spread flags definitional variance. No sub-segment values disclosed.

data_points.methodology: Year-on-year growth computed from the two adjacent annual values published on the fetched Mordor page: USD 1.32bn (2025) to USD 1.39bn (2026). 1.39/1.32-1 = 5.30%. Assumptions: both values are same-definition, same-basis, and stated to 3 significant figures, so the derived rate carries rounding error of roughly +/-0.8pp. Sensitivity: on the unrounded band (1.315-1.325 to 1.385-1.395) the implied growth ranges 4.5-6.1%. FORWARD-LOOKING: 2026 is inside Mordor's forecast window (2026-2031), so this is a projected growth rate, not an observed one.
data_points.notes: This is a FORECAST year-on-year rate, not an actual. No observed Korean-source YoY for domestic hair care could be verified on a fetchable page. Consistent with the same source's 5.42% CAGR (2026-2031). cf IMARC 3.23% CAGR (2026-2034) already on file — Mordor runs ~2pp hotter; the two aggregators also disagree on level (Mordor USD 1.32bn 2025 vs IMARC USD 1.8bn 2025, a 1.36x gap), definitional mismatch unresolved.
